description.value: Bright Eye Brewing is a craft brewery and pub on Kamloops' North Shore, pouring house-brewed beers alongside a full kitchen menu of pizzas, burgers, wraps, salads, and small bites. The venue features a 'brewcade' — a combination brewery and arcade — and welcomes all ages when accompanied by an adult. Both dine-in and pick-up ordering are available, making it a practical refuelling stop for cyclists riding Tranquille Road.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content confirms Bright Eye Brewing is an active craft brewery and pub at 292 Tranquille Road, Kamloops, with dine-in and pick-up service; phone, address, and email all match OSM tags exactly. The menu explicitly notes vegan-adaptable and gluten-friendly items, and the homepage banner and cart feature confirm pick-up ordering. No website content mentions bike racks, bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or device charging, so those amenity fields remain null.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active brewery and pub with dine-in and pick-up service on a key Kamloops cycling corridor; a clear food-and-drink stop for touring cyclists. Bike parking is unconfirmed but the business is otherwise a strong WWC fit.
